# Kakatong 家家通

> The community directory and review platform for Chinese-community families in
> NYC — home care, tutoring, kids activities, and adult training. Free to browse
> and read public provider info; families contribute and read community reviews.
> Kakatong lists providers' public information and does not independently verify
> any provider's license or credentials.

## Four verticals

- Kakatong Care — Chinese-speaking home aides, elder care, child care
- Kakatong Learn — SHSAT/SAT/AP test prep, tutoring, Chinese school, coding & STEM (7 subcategories)
- Kakatong Kids — music, swim, martial arts, dance, art, elementary learning, chess (K-8)
- Kakatong Pro — adult training: real estate, healthcare (HHA), driving, coding & tech, citizenship, insurance, professional English (ESL)

## Coverage

NYC metro today — Flushing, Manhattan Chinatown, Sunset Park, Bayside and nearby.
Bay Area expansion planned.

## Languages

English · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · Español
